Name reservation Official

Three slots, nine names

Oct 27 to Nov 3, any pack qualifies, and only 3 characters can be reserved. The rest are claimed at launch.

Locked at reservation: class and ruleset. Names are two parts, unique as a pair per region. Blizzard has not announced field length limits, so the letter counts shown are for reference. Only Normal, PvP and RP are offered at reservation; Hardcore comes later.
Backup names Inference

Plan B and Plan C

Reservation is first-come, first-served. Keep two fallbacks per character and use Ideas to generate more.

Rulesets Community

One choice you cannot undo

Forever has no realm list. The ruleset you pick at character creation is permanent, and parties, dungeons and raids cannot cross rulesets or factions.

Normal

World PvP needs consent from both players. The default for most players.

PvP

Contested zones stay dangerous, with faction-balance mechanics.

Roleplaying

Normal rules with a roleplay community focus.

Hardcore

A fully enclosed ecosystem. Launches after Nov 4 with no date announced. A dead Hardcore character may transfer to another ruleset.

For this roster: keep all nine on the same ruleset. Otherwise your own characters cannot group, and the Mage and Druid mains could not run dungeons with the alts. Inference

Leveling notes

What is known about the 1 to 60 route

Published so far Community

  • Level cap is 60 and permanent. The beta showed levels 20 to 30; ForeverChanges lists 35 dungeons in all.
  • Zephras Isle is the level 1 to 12 start for the new Skyborne race only.
  • Riverglades covers roughly the mid-30s to mid-40s, with more than 150 new quests.
  • Mount Hyjal and Shen'dralas follow in the 40s and up, without published ranges.
  • Dungeon quest XP is much higher and mob-kill XP is much lower. Campfires grant rested XP, and Well Fed food gives a small XP buff.
  • No level scaling: zones keep a fixed difficulty.

Not yet published Official

  • Starting zones for Human, Dwarf, Gnome and Night Elf are not detailed in any source found.
  • Dungeon ranges are listed only by a community site (ForeverChanges): Blackfathom Deeps and The Stockade 24 to 32, Excavation Site 26 to 31, City of Dalaran 28 to 33, Gnomeregan and Razorfen Kraul 29 to 38. Blizzard has not published a full list.
  • Field length limits for the two-part name are not announced.
  • Hardcore is listed for winter 2026 to 27 by ForeverChanges, with no exact date. Major updates are listed for spring and summer 2027.

These gaps were re-checked against ForeverChanges on Oct 31, after the beta ended on Oct 23.

Field notes

What changes in Forever

Legacy system Community

Account-wide points, up to 65 at launch and 16 spendable per character. Class levels (25, 45, 60) and profession thresholds (150, 225, 300) each pay out the first time. A nine-class roster is built for it.

Campsites Community

Every profession has three tiers of campsite crafts that buff the party. Tier 1 recipes unlock at skill 20, better blueprints drop from dungeon bosses, and Cooking is required for all campfires.

Talents and stats Community

Every class gets revised trees with a new 16-point milestone. DoTs can crit, and Hit and Crit are unified across melee, ranged and spells. Level 60 is permanent.

Corrected since the spreadsheet

The Paladin's Jewelcrafting is gone: it is not a Forever profession. Jeraziah Dawnhammer now runs Mining and Blacksmithing.

Professions, Oct 29

Maviand Swiftclaw now takes Skinning and Leatherworking. Seraphina Raytinker takes Herbalism and Alchemy. Wildheart Stonestride still has Skinning and Leatherworking, so those two overlap until he changes.

Reservation, Oct 27

Reserved: Pyrax Emberspanner (Mage), Maviand Swiftclaw (Druid) and Cassian Ironvow (Warrior). Pyrolord and Legionaire (and their variations) were rejected as names, so the Mage and Warrior were renamed.

Roster refresh, Oct 26

After the racial changes: Pyrolord is back to Gnome as Pyrolord Emberspanner, Wildheart Stonestride a Dwarf Hunter, Vex Galewhisper a Skyborne Rogue and Jeraziah Dawnhammer the Human Paladin. Seraphina moves to Tailoring plus Enchanting so all nine primaries stay covered, and Malachai takes Engineering to fit his Gnome fantasy.

Sources disagree on one date

Blizzard's own post says launch is Nov 4 at 3:00 PM PST. One outlet lists Nov 5. This page uses Nov 4.
